models.name: Ward 176 hydraulic reconstructed candidate
models.description: Current reconstructed Ward 176 EPA SWMM candidate model (Dynamic Wave, CMS). Controlled candidate model; not calibrated or field-validated.

networkMapping.description: Model link IDs (Cxxx) equal recon_conduit_id; model node IDs (Jnnn/OUTnnn) equal the resolved reconstructed node number. Source GCC ObjectIDs are kept separately.

limitations: Drainage network connectivity is incomplete; multiple network components remain disconnected.
Outfalls in the model are provisional downstream boundary terminals, not confirmed physical outfalls.
Some GCC source invert attributes are internally inconsistent (e.g. C162, C175); they are retained and flagged, not corrected.
Manning roughness, depression storage and Green-Ampt infiltration values are first-pass modelling assumptions.
Subcatchments are first-pass GIS-derived model constructs, not official hydrological catchments.
The model is not calibrated or field-validated; SWMM flooding loss is a model diagnostic, not observed flood volume.
SWMM is a 1D drainage/hydraulic model; it does not produce a 2D/3D flood surface.

diagnosticContext.description: Curated findings of the project's prior hydraulic investigations for links that appear in SWMM numerical diagnostics. Context only: they are not bottleneck evidence and do not change the model.

C162.finding: Geometrically real 3.03 m segment. Its source inverts conflict with neighbouring GCC records at J122 and J124, so the model junction elevations are compromises (reconstructed with conduit offsets). A junction/invert-data problem, not evidence for deletion or a confirmed hydraulic failure.
C162.decision: RETAIN; do not fabricate an elevation correction

C166.finding: Genuine 10.06 m segment in an incomplete network component (with C168, terminal J135) that has no verified outfall. Source geometry does not support a missing short connection. Its numerical instability is a property of the incomplete component, not evidence of a real-world flood hotspot.
C166.decision: RETAIN; flag incomplete component; do not invent a connection

C175.finding: Short lateral/branch-like 6.11 m segment. Its source invert attributes are identical to C174 (36.1 m), which suggests a source-attribute artifact; geometry supports a real branch/crossing.
C175.decision: RETAIN; FLAG source-invert ambiguity pending manhole/drop evidence

C180.finding: Genuine split piece of GCC ObjectID 5916 at its intersection with ObjectID 5918 (not a fabricated gap connection). The remaining issue is the J203/J204 junction elevation interpretation, not C180 geometry.

C190.finding: Previously the only SWMM Warning 04 (minimum elevation drop applied); end inverts are now preserved through conduit offsets.
C190.decision: RETAIN; revisit with better invert/manhole data
